mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 4.5% indicates tightening monetary policy, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.5%, labor market tightness fuels wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between INDPRO and HOUST: when both increase by more than 1% in a month, supply chain resilience and housing market strength combine to predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this interaction-driven signal remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: RSAFS growth rate is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as consumer spending drives economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between RSAFS growth and SPX 60d returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.01).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered signal: when CPIAUCSL exceeds 305, inflation concerns lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL above 305.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional signal: in a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4%), PAYEMS growth is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but this relationship flips in high-unemployment regimes.
failure_condition: In low-unemployment regimes, walk-forward correlation between PAYEMS growth and SPX 5d returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.01).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven signal: the combined effect of INDPRO and FEDFUNDS predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as supply chain resilience interacts with monetary policy to influence equity markets.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this interaction-driven signal remains below 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
